name: shittake lentil soup
instructions:
The clean lentil soup (formerly 'the clean version / variant A' of the dissolved mushroomed-lentils-british file — decided the best of that line). DARK STOCK + TOMATO backbone, SHIITAKE mushrooms, LIMITED FAT, LIMITED VEGETABLES outside of onion.

=== THE BUILD ===

- ONIONS + SHIITAKE MUSHROOMS + SPANISH PARDINA LENTILS — the lentil is specified: spanish pardinas are a SURGICAL FIT here (pivotal — they pair with the shiitakes).
- DARK BROTH + chunky whole TOMATO + TOMATO PASTE — the espagnole-style backbone. NO MARMITE.
- WORCESTERSHIRE: YES.
- LIMITED FAT — skipped the butter (and fat entirely) and it was fine.
- HERBS: FRESH ROSEMARY + THYME (not dried) + BAY LEAF.
- LIMITED VEGETABLES — no celery/carrot, no garlic; onion carries the aromatics.
- BLACK PEPPER. (POTATO was formerly cut up inside — REVERSED 2026-11-17: I wouldn't add potato to this soup. See the contrast note.)
- NO LEMON, NO CUMIN/SPICE.
- BARLEY — a good addition, baseline now.

=== METHOD — INSTAPOT, 15 MINUTES ===

INSTAPOT, 15 MINUTES — the lentils and the BROTH EXTRACTION happen AT THE SAME TIME. Key to its success, along with the fresh-not-dried rosemary + thyme.
notes:
Split out 2026-10-31 from the dissolved mushroomed-lentils-british file, where it was 'the clean version' — decided the BEST of that line (beating both the Nisha wellington and the Jamie cottage-pie scaffold it shared the file with).

=== WHY IT WORKS ===

- SPANISH PARDINA LENTILS were PIVOTAL — they pair with the shiitakes. The lentil is SPECIFIED, not a slot: pardinas are a surgical fit for this soup (generic lentils demoted out of secondary accordingly).
- INSTAPOT (15 min) does the lentils and the broth extraction AT THE SAME TIME — key to its success.
- FRESH rosemary + thyme, not dried — also key.
- DARK STOCK + TOMATO (the espagnole combo) just goes great with mushrooms — same backbone logic as [[french-beef-and-mushroom-stew]]. (This line used to say 'and potatoes' — potato reversed out 2026-11-17, see the contrast note.)

=== NO MARMITE — THE ANCHOR IS THE STOCK ===

The dark-anchor slot holds ONE thing: here it's the dark stock. MARMITE + DARK STOCK stacked is too much MSG (the lesson from [[pub-style-lentils]]'s marmite build, where marmite holds the slot and the stock is clashing instead). Marmite is clashing here on that basis.

=== LIMITED FAT, LIMITED VEGETABLES ===

Skipped the butter — and fat entirely — and it was FINE; fat is optional-to-limited here. Vegetables stay limited to the ONION (no celery, no carrot, no garlic) — the cleanness is the identity. The CHUNKY TOMATOES are THE BEST PART — both tomato forms are in (chunky whole tomato + tomato paste).

=== ROSEMARY NOTE (THE UNSOLVED RULE) ===

Rosemary rides happily against the dark-stock anchor here with NO celery/carrot in the pot — while the celery + tomato forward stews ([[french-lentils]], the retired italian mushroomed lentils) refuse it. Whether the mechanism is the dark anchor, 'something meaty', or the celery itself is UNSOLVED — [[chicken-pot-pie]] has celery AND rosemary happily, so no theory is clean yet.

=== BARLEY — PROMOTED TO BASELINE ===

Barley is a good addition — it should be baseline. Formerly want-to-try (mushroom-barley territory; it fits the register), now confirmed.

=== CONTRAST WITH THE PUB STEW (2026-11-17) ===

The difference between this soup (SILKY, LIGHT) and [[pub-style-lentils]]: MUSHROOM CHOICE (shittakes here, cremini there), plus the pub version's inclusion of BUTTER + PORCINI POWDER — while this soup uses diced whole tomato, shittakes, and no spices/seasonings or fat. (The pub stew's smoke, it turns out, comes from the mushrooms/butter/porcini — not the marmite and cumin; its anchor can even be this soup's dark stock + tomato paste.)

REFRAME (2026-11-17, same day): in the pub stew, the espagnole sauce (INCLUDING THE BUTTER) + PORCINI POWDER + cremini/portabella is enough to make a SMOKY stew, which directs what else tastes good there (potatoes and garlic yes, raw tomato no). This soup is so similar (mushrooms, dark stock, tomato, lentils), but the LACK OF BUTTER, PORCINI POWDER, and portabella/cremini makes it SOMETHING ELSE ENTIRELY — which is why I wouldn't add POTATO here. Potato REVERSED out of the build accordingly (it was primary since the 2026-10-31 split; moved to clashing).

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[pub-style-lentils]]: the anchored pub sibling — the marmite + cumin + lemon build (Jamie Oliver's line, served with mash) and the ale + pickle build, merged into one recipe.
- [[french-lentils]]: the mustard + cream + potato stew.
- the retired italian mushroomed lentils is RETIRED — it was converging on this recipe anyway (dark broth + fresh tomato + shiitake) and wasn't going anywhere.
